description: Land Title Settlement Department - Nuwara Wewa, Nuwaragam Palatha East D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110190
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, extents, ownership details, and encumbrances. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land ownership and title settlement, making it clearly a Land Gazette according to the classification criteria.
